properties.rationale: Standing acknowledgement, re-stated because the rollup's id hashes the affected set and moves whenever the capability set does — 61, 62, 63, 64, now 65. Validation for this project is the trials programme: reflow2 used on real designs. In two days that meant an adopt pass over dynograph-foundation, a live two-session seam exercise, a consumer-side compatibility build against an unreleased provider tree, and a release cut — which between them found seven defects nobody reviewed their way to, five of them in reflow2 itself. Recording 65 near-identical validation nodes would turn the number green without anyone having checked anything, which is the dishonesty `dec:passing-is-verified` exists to prevent.
